fuel_consumption.source_quote: Aircraft fuel costs of $86,064,000 for 89,236,000 gallons used resulted in an average fuel cost of 96 cents per gallon for the year ended March 31, 2003.

instrument_type_details.notes: Fuel hedging program initiated November 2002. Instruments: (1) Nov 2002 swap: 770K gal/month Dec 2002-May 2003 at 72.25 cents/gal (~10% of requirements); (2) Nov 2002 three-way collar: 385K gal/month Dec 2002-Nov 2003 at cap 82c/primary floor 72c/secondary floor 64.5c (~5% of requirements); (3) March 2003 swap: 1.26M gal/month Apr-Jun 2003 at 79.25c (~15% of Q); (4) April 2003 swap: 1.26M gal/month Jul-Dec 2003 at 71.53c (~15% of Q). FY2003 results: unrealized derivative LOSS of $167,046; realized GAIN of $726,000 from cash settlements. As of June 23, 2003 (subsequent): ~15.7% of FY2004 fuel hedged.
